import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        int n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine().trim());

        int[] A_vals = Arrays.stream(br.readLine().trim().split(" "))
                            .mapToInt(Integer::parseInt).toArray();
        int[] B_vals = Arrays.stream(br.readLine().trim().split(" "))
                            .mapToInt(Integer::parseInt).toArray();

        int[] A_orig = A_vals.clone();
        int[] B_orig = B_vals.clone();

        System.out.println((n - maxLoss(A_orig, B_orig)) + " " + maxWin(A_vals, B_vals));
    }

    static int maxWin(int[] A_list, int[] B_list) {
        int total = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            int opponent_idx = (i + 1) % 3;
            int wins = Math.min(A_list[i], B_list[opponent_idx]);
            A_list[i] -= wins;
            B_list[opponent_idx] -= wins;
            total += wins;
        }
        return total;
    }

    static int maxLoss(int[] A_list, int[] B_list) {
        int[][] move_pairs = { {0, 2}, {1, 0}, {2, 1}, {0, 0}, {1, 1}, {2, 2} };
        List<int[][]> all_permutations = generatePermutations(move_pairs);
        int max_loss_value = 0;

        for (int[][] perm : all_permutations) {
            int[] A_copy = A_list.clone();
            int[] B_copy = B_list.clone();
            int[] losses = {0, 0, 0};
            for (int[] move : perm) {
                int loss_amount = Math.min(A_copy[move[0]], B_copy[move[1]]);
                A_copy[move[0]] -= loss_amount;
                B_copy[move[1]] -= loss_amount;
                losses[move[0]] += loss_amount;
            }
            int total_loss = Arrays.stream(losses).sum();
            if (total_loss > max_loss_value) {
                max_loss_value = total_loss;
            }
        }
        return max_loss_value;
    }

    static List<int[][]> generatePermutations(int[][] move_pairs) {
        List<int[][]> permutations = new ArrayList<>();
        permute(move_pairs, 0, permutations);
        return permutations;
    }

    static void permute(int[][] arr, int l, List<int[][]> permutations) {
        if (l == arr.length - 1) {
            int[][] perm = new int[arr.length][2];
            for (int i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
                perm[i] = arr[i].clone();
            }
            permutations.add(perm);
        } else {
            for (int i = l; i < arr.length; i++) {
                swap(arr, l, i);
                permute(arr, l + 1, permutations);
                swap(arr, l, i);
            }
        }
    }

    static void swap(int[][] arr, int i, int j) {
        int[] temp = arr[i];
        arr[i] = arr[j];
        arr[j] = temp;
    }
}
